official_definition: (Zero) Rebirth: X or less Counters (Only one Rebirth can be used at a time) When either (Condition A) or this Spirit leaves the field due to the opponent, put 20px on this Spirit and it is Reborn.

ownership_rules.native_syntax: Ability block header contains [Zero Rebirth] or [Zero Rebirth: Param]
ownership_rules.prose_exclusion: Mentions inside body clauses ("with [Zero Rebirth]", "give [Zero Rebirth]") classified as REFERENCES or GRANTED, never NATIVE.

resolution.description: Mutates game state as specified by official effect text.
